content.caption: Trouble Section

Fuel gauge
Water temp. gauge | Lights do not dim when light and rheostat S/W turned ON.

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for fuel and temperature gauges that do not dim. Starts with two parallel checks - one for fuel gauge and one for temp gauge, then converges to a common diagnostic path involving speedometer check and voltage tests.

content.text:
Only fuel gauge?
(Does temp. gauge dim?)

Only temp. gauge?
(Does temp. gauge dim?)

Only fuel and temp. gauges do not dim?
(Speedometer OK?)

① With the ignition S/W at ON position and connector of fuel and temp. gauges disconnected, check that there is voltage between terminals of the connector as follows:
3 — 5  Light S/W ON                    4.0 — 6.0V
       Light S/W OFF                    0 — 1.0V
4 — 5  Light S/W turned ON              OK
       Rheostat turned OFF
       (Rheostat operate (MIN — MAX)  3.0 — 6.0V
                                       0 — 3.8V

content.description: Wiring diagram showing fuel and temp gauges connected to a voltmeter. The diagram shows a gauge unit on the left, a connector harness in the center with terminals labeled GND, TC②, and TR②, and a voltmeter at the bottom for testing.
